extras.real_size: machete 60 cm (blade 46 cm) on a wooden display stand, 71 cm long, 18 cm high
extras.notes: broad single-edged steel blade with a straight spine and a belly rising to a blunt rounded tip (clean, no nicks), honey wood grip with three brass rivets per side, brass ferrule and end cap; the machete rests upright (edge up) in two walnut forks with blue felt pads on a walnut base board; long axis = X; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
